scenes.title: Buying one? Check these 5 things first.
Check the year.
scenes.body: 2007–11 have the 3.8 and a 4-speed auto. 2012-on get the Pentastar most buyers want.

scenes.title: Look for oil under the plenum.
scenes.body: The Pentastar's plastic oil filter housing has a habit of cracking.

scenes.title: Jack it up.
scenes.body: Ball joints wear fast on 35s. Drive it at 45–65 mph to rule out death wobble.

scenes.title: Listen for a tick.
scenes.body: A tick that fades as it warms is usually snapped exhaust manifold bolts.

scenes.title: Prove the hardware works.
scenes.body: Both lockers, the sway-bar disconnect and the 4:1 Rock-Trac low range.
